title: Human + AI Solidity CTF: bring your own agent
description:
This is our first CTF designed for a world where agents can outplay humans. Play as a human, as a human + AI, or as a fully autonomous agent. 

Prepare your setup and compete to be the first to capture all 12 flags and win prizes. Winners will share the details of their setup: what they told their agents, when they stepped in, and how they recovered from failures. 

It's a great opportunity to see real agent setups under pressure and take the best ideas home for your own.
